attestations.reason: Replacing the first-unsupported-member preference with the last unsupported member cannot grant outcome support: every selected member is still examined and any unsupported inventory leaves a nonempty, attributable refusal. The contract requires an actual unsupported contributor to be named, not a priority among multiple such contributors. Subjects and execution binding are unchanged, and recorded refusal text is rehashed verbatim rather than reselected at check time.
